# m92-pi - CRT through the first RGB-Pi, GPIO to SCART (read by config.txt)
# 240p at 15.72 kHz and 60.01 Hz in RGB, as the arcade board. The sound
# goes to the SCART on GPIO 18 and 19: on a Pi 3 only, for now.
# Each game pixel is 5 DPI pixels wide: the Pi 3 needs a fast clock.
enable_dpi_lcd=1
display_default_lcd=1
dpi_output_format=6
dpi_group=2
dpi_mode=87
dpi_timings=1600 1 80 160 280 240 1 3 3 16 0 0 0 60 0 33333333 1
gpio=2-9,12-17,20-25=a2
gpio=18,19=a5
